name: The Second Bottle Tree of the Botanic Garden

location.address: Jardi Botanic de la Universitat de Valencia, Carrer Quart 80, 46008 Valencia

verified_sources: data/registers/valencia-arboles-monumentales.json (register_id 1144, 'Arbre botella del Botanic II', species Brachychiton populneus, girth 2.88m, height 30.1m, crown 13.8m)

https://jardibotanic.org/index.php?apid=cataleg_virtual_despecies-220&idioma=_spa&pid=352 (garden's own virtual species catalogue, confirms Brachychiton populneus, common name BRAQUIQUITO/KURRAJONG, held in the garden's Escuela Botanica collection)
access: Paid entry to the Jardi Botanic (small fee), same garden as the Kashmir Cypress and the other Botanic Garden specimens
transport: 10 min walk from Angel Guimera metro station
verify_notes: This is the SECOND of the garden's two register-listed 'bottle trees': register_id 1143 ('Arbre botella del Botanic I', Ceiba speciosa) is already published as vlc_017. This one, register_id 1144, is Brachychiton populneus, a different genus that shares the same Spanish common name 'arbol botella' informally, which is what caused an earlier pass to flag a species ambiguity (a jardibotanic.org page it found described a bottle tree as Brachychiton discolor, in the same garden). That ambiguity is resolved here: jardibotanic.org's own catalogue independently lists a Brachychiton populneus specifically (not discolor), under its own common name BRAQUIQUITO/KURRAJONG (distinct from 'arbol botella'), held in the Escuela Botanica collection, which matches the register's species assignment for this individual. The catalogue page describes the species generally rather than this specific trunk's measurements, so it corroborates identity and presence in the collection rather than confirming which exact tree, the same caveat already carried by vlc_022 in this cluster. No age or planting date found anywhere. Alive: the Jardi Botanic is an active, currently operating institution (confirmed via its own live website, fetched 2026-09-09).
